import csv, os, random
random.seed(7)
with open(os.environ['OUT'], 'w', newline='') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['id', 'value'])
    for i in range(1, 101):
        w.writerow([i, round(random.uniform(10.0, 20.0), 3)])

import csv, glob, os, statistics
src = sorted(glob.glob('../../dataset/t*/out'), key=lambda p: int(p.split('/t')[-1].split('/')[0]))[-1]
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(src, newline='')))
values = [float(r['value']) for r in rows]
with open(os.environ['OUT'], 'w') as f:
    f.write('# Synthetic report\n\n')
    f.write(f'rows: {len(rows)}\n')
    f.write(f'mean: {statistics.mean(values):.3f}\n')
    f.write(f'min: {min(values):.3f}\n')
    f.write(f'max: {max(values):.3f}\n')
